propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters that are supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP
FastMCP derives JSON schemas and input validation from handwritten callable signatures; undeclared parameters are discarded before the adapter runs
The MCP adapter delegate calls forward only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, so even if signatures declared the fields, they would still be lost
The operator ruling (2026-08-18) rescinds the force-only policy and establishes parity across all surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with absent certification as the audit signal
Repair requires adding library-compatible parameters to MCP signatures and forwarding all parameters unchanged through the adapter to the shared core library
